title: KP generated transform library loop

goal: Run the KP generated transform-library promotion slices without broadening into stale Theseus planner follow-ups.
stopConditions: Stop if a slice requires changing semantic object architecture outside the generated transform-library boundary.
Stop if focused tests fail in a way that needs product or math-semantics judgment.
Stop before implementing renderer animation effects that are not represented by semantic transformations or visual motif defaults.
Stop after the ninth slice and rerun long-loop-report before considering renderer frame adoption, dashboard authoring actions, media, curriculum, or dynamic package loading.
allowedWork: Work only on generated transform-library definitions, fixture consumption, dashboard/export surfacing, and visual motif default law wiring.
Use the source refs and verification commands recorded on each slice.
Keep template convenience separate from SemanticObject or SemanticTransformation type expansion.
disallowedWork: Do not work on stale Theseus planner follow-ups in this KP loop.
Do not implement GIF/video encoders, curriculum generation, package loading, or graph/runtime unification in this loop.
Do not add visual-only effects without semantic or motif contract coverage.
